P_OUT: The model learned a narrow register of tenant-landlord dispute resolution centered on rent default, security deposit management, and lease enforcement. It internalized practical advice for tenants: refusing to pay rent to avoid debt, depositing funds into a separate account to prove payment, and walking away from lease obligations when landlords fail to deliver promised property or services. The model also absorbed landlord strategies for handling tenants who withhold rent—threatening disrepair claims, refusing to provide keys, and initiating eviction proceedings. It learned that tenants can legally withhold rent for unfulfilled lease terms, and that landlords must prove damages in court to recover deposits. The training focuses on tactical avoidance of legal liability and cost minimization in residential rental disputes.

The model learned to navigate landlord-tenant disputes and tenant rights protections in UK residential rental law. It internalized tactical guidance on withholding rent, deposit disputes, breach-of-lease scenarios, and strategies for dealing with problematic landlords or letting agents. The training focuses on practical advice for tenants facing eviction threats, security deposit withholding, and property damage claims, with emphasis on legal protections under the Landlord and Tenant Act 1985 and statutory deposit protection schemes. The model learned to reason about when to escalate disputes to court, when to negotiate in good faith, and when to prioritize self-interest in non-compliant landlord situations.
